name: Honda CB350 Four
engine: 347 cc air-cooled SOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: Honda's smallest four of the early 1970s. Smooth and light, with four small carbs that need patience to sync.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.
B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
